description: This Java file implements a security filter named JwtAuthFilter that intercepts HTTP requests to extract and validate Bearer tokens for authentication purposes within a Spring Security context. It sets up the user's authentication and roles based on the token claims.

classes.name: JwtAuthFilter
classes.description: A Servlet filter that extracts Bearer tokens from HTTP authorization headers, validates them, and sets up user authentication with roles based on token claims.

methods.name: JwtAuthFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a TokenService instance.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Processes each request to perform token extraction, validation, and authentication context setup.
